notes.title: Are you ready for an Endless Nightmare...on your Mac?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32664592/eda75ad5e60b6bf330991d1d4eba055054e1e7d2.png[/img]

The 7th Circle - Endless Nightmare is now available for Mac users! This major updates marks a new beginning for our First Person Dungeon Crawler RPG, thanks to the amazing work by 68KStudios! This new version of the game comes with 4 new dungeons and an original Inferno Mode to let you all face new challenges! Here it is a recap of all the fixes we've done even for our Mac friends:

[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32664592/b71382ab4a511bede262013d1ca095c85293d78a.png[/img] 4 additional terriyfing dungeons
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32664592/b71382ab4a511bede262013d1ca095c85293d78a.png[/img] New incredible INFERNO mode
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32664592/b71382ab4a511bede262013d1ca095c85293d78a.png[/img] Volume Settings 100% working
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32664592/b71382ab4a511bede262013d1ca095c85293d78a.png[/img] Various improvements and minor bugs solved
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32664592/b71382ab4a511bede262013d1ca095c85293d78a.png[/img] Carnage mode now properly working with gamepad
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32664592/b71382ab4a511bede262013d1ca095c85293d78a.png[/img] Poisonous Oils' limit fixed
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32664592/b71382ab4a511bede262013d1ca095c85293d78a.png[/img] Fullscreen Mode now properly working in lower res
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32664592/b71382ab4a511bede262013d1ca095c85293d78a.png[/img] Negative damage inflicted in high difficulty level now fixed
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32664592/b71382ab4a511bede262013d1ca095c85293d78a.png[/img] Bag screen and text issues completely fixed
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32664592/b71382ab4a511bede262013d1ca095c85293d78a.png[/img] Improved total armor value calculation
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32664592/b71382ab4a511bede262013d1ca095c85293d78a.png[/img] Optimized UI
[/list]

tags.bug: Various improvements and minor bugs solved
Carnage mode now properly working with gamepad
Fullscreen Mode now properly working in lower res
Negative damage inflicted in high difficulty level now fixed
Bag screen and text issues completely fixed

notes.title: Version 1.1.14
notes.content:
Version 1.1.14 is now available for Windows and Linux.

[list]
[*] Full key rebinding (Combat and Exploration)
[*] A couple of small fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1.10: New Dungeons
notes.content:
Version 1.1.10
[list]
    [*]2 new "postgame" dungeons available: level 17 and 18. Beat the last boss and restart the game with a new character to enter Level 17.
    [*]Bug fix
    [*]Increased the power of enemies in the advanced levels.
[/list]

tags.feature: 2 new "postgame" dungeons available: level 17 and 18. Beat the last boss and restart the game with a new character to enter Level 17.

tags.balance_change: Increased the power of enemies in the advanced levels.

notes.title: Version 1.1.3: Gamepad support and more
notes.content:
Version 1.1.3 is live right now.

Features:

[list]
    [*]Gamepad support
    [*]You can now set the volume for Music and SFX.
    [*]"Suicide" option: press SHIFT+K during combat to kill your Alter Ego. Doing so you can spend Blood Drops to upgrade pillars and chose a new path for the next character.
[/list]

tags.feature: [list]     [*]You can now set the volume for Music and SFX.
"Suicide" option: press SHIFT+K during combat to kill your Alter Ego. Doing so you can spend Blood Drops to upgrade pillars and chose a new path for the next character.

notes.title: Version 1.0.21 live now
notes.content:
Some changes regarding difficulty and game balance:
[list]
    [*]Enemies now have higher armour value. This will give an advantage to spellcaster because spells ignore armour.
    [*]Reduced the SPEED value for enemies on HARD, EXTREME and NIGHTMARE difficulties
    [*]Fixed XP and BLOOD DROPS gain on HARD, EXTREME and NIGHTMARE difficulties.
[/list]
